comment: Wizard-mode Valkyrie on the Val-goal quest level, whose southern drawbridge is lowered. A controlled teleport lands south of the span, the hero steps onto it and creates a tame kitten on its north (doorway) side, swaps onto the kitten's square (the kitten moves onto the span), then swaps back. The final step is domove_swap_with_pet() with the destination monster on DRAWBRIDGE_DOWN, which test_move() admits as ordinary terrain.
